column2: PDFium writes g*255 and skips the transfer function; pdf.js's reference formula 295.8*L^(1/3)-40.8 is what calgray.pdf expects
PDFium paints stored premultiplied samples opaquely and ignores /SMaskInData for 1 and 2; pdf.js un-premultiplies with /Matte
PDFium blends the nested non-isolated subgroup against the parent's blue (red*blue, green*blue = black); the group has to blend against its own initial backdrop
PDFium paints the d1-stencil shadow neutral grey; a d1 glyph is filled in the text colour (red, ISO 32000-1 9.5.5) and MuPDF renders it red on 92% of those pixels, siding with Poso
